text:
maria_g: FYI vendor just flagged a partial DOA on one pallet of the H100s — arriving at FRA crossdock today. they want to split return vs. forward units and are asking if we can consolidate RMAs to a single AWB to save brokerage. AWB: 987-6543210
kevin_ops: can you paste the carrier and photos? we need evidence for the claim and to decide split vs consolidate. also what's ETA for remaining good units?
alex_builds: from infra side — we can accept a staggered handoff but need serials up front to tag to nodes. if the good units get delayed >48h we might need temporary loaners.
nexasupply: carrier: AeroFreight DE, pallet ID PF-4432. photos uploaded to the ticket (link: https://files.nexasupply.com/claim/4432). ETA for good units is 12:30 CET, damaged pallet currently held for inspection. vendor suggests: consolidate RMAs into single AWB to Frankfurt depot, vendor covers partial brokerage if we agree.
maria_g: thanks. liz_finance do we have precedent for accepting vendor brokerage credit and letting them reconsign to one AWB? last time it saved ~€1.2k in clearance fees.
liz_finance: we can approve vendor covering brokerage up to €1500 but need a PO amendment and invoice note. please add cost center and cc the finance mailbox.
kevin_ops: ops question: if we consolidate, does that change HS code handling or customs paperwork? FRA customs are picky about mixed-status SKUs.
nexasupply: consolidation will still use same HS codes. we'll mark the damaged units as RMA lines on the manifest and attach the inspection report. we need go-ahead by 10:00 CET to make the AWB change before carrier cut-off.
ops-bot: Reminder: FRA carrier cut-off 10:30 CET for AeroFreight today.
alex_builds: from cluster health POV, schedule: we can hot-swap serials as they arrive. if vendor consolidates and delays handoff >8h we want temporary capacity swap. Maria, can you confirm loaner pool availability?
maria_g: checking — current loaner pool in EU: 8 H100s free, but 3 are earmarked for a customer test. we can free 2 if needed.
kevin_ops: decision time — propose: 1) approve consolidation AWB if vendor signs brokerage credit + PO amendment; 2) vendor provides inspection report and photo set + serial list pre-cutover; 3) we plan for 2 loaners to be pressed if ETA >12h. agree?
liz_finance: agreed on finance side pending PO amendment and final invoice note.
nexasupply: can sign PO amendment and provide inspection report by 09:45 CET. will confirm AWB change by 09:55 CET if approved.
alex_builds: ok — I'll prep node reassignment plan and hold a 30m ops window at 13:00 CET in case of staggered handoff.
maria_g: i'll push vendor to sign amendment and will update here when AWB is changed. tagging @kevin_ops for final thumbs up. :thumbsup:
kevin_ops: thumbs up from me. maria please cc finance and ops when amendment is in. :white_check_mark:
nexasupply: AWB updated to 111-2223334, consolidation confirmed. inspection report attached to ticket.
ops-bot: Ticket #3482 updated: AWB change recorded, inspection report uploaded.
maria_g: got it, cc'd finance (liz_finance) and ops (kevin_ops). scheduling handoff with FRA depot now.
alex_builds: will monitor for serial list, will start hot-swap prep.
liz_finance: invoice amendment received, vendor brokerage credit noted. finance will process refund to ledger after RMA closes.
kevin_ops: closing loop — thanks team. action items: maria get final manifest to ops by 11:30 CET; alex standby for 13:00 CET window; liz to finalize PO amendment.
maria_g: on it.
kevin_ops: :rocket:
